description: This file contains utility functions for graph manipulation in PyTorch FX, including topological sorting, validation, node fusion, subgraph insertion, and partition-based fusion, used for optimizing or transforming computational graphs.

methods.name: topo_sort
methods.description: Performs a topological sort on a list of nodes based on their dependencies.

methods.name: validate_partition
methods.description: Checks if a partition of nodes in a graph contains dependency cycles.

methods.name: fuse_as_graphmodule
methods.description: Fuses a list of nodes into a new GraphModule, creating a subgraph representing the fused nodes.

methods.name: insert_subgm
methods.description: Inserts a subgraph GraphModule into a parent GraphModule at the appropriate position.

methods.name: erase_nodes
methods.description: Removes specified nodes from a GraphModule in reverse topological order.

methods.name: fuse_by_partitions
methods.description: Fuses multiple partitions of nodes within a GraphModule into submodules, replacing the original nodes.
